instruments.name: Square Lead
instruments.description: A hollow, woody square wave with a firm sustain for melodies that need to sit forward.

instruments.name: Acid Bass
instruments.description: A squelchy, resonant sawtooth with a snapping filter and glide, in the spirit of the TB-303.

instruments.name: Drawbar Organ
instruments.description: Sine and triangle stops an octave below, at, and above the note, held steady like a tonewheel organ.

instruments.name: Muted Pluck
instruments.description: A dark, quickly damped string like palm-muted guitar or pizzicato, for rhythmic chugs.
